newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barges firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barges firm.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil barge prices were firmer on Tuesday but cargoes values were notional amid severe volatility on the futures, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded at $108 to $110 fob ARA in the morning then numbers slipped back and deals were heard done in the afternoon at $107.
Low sulphur barges were hardly talked but dealers doubted their prices were far above those of high sulphur.
Cargo levels were notional. Demand was seen from traders and at least one utility but no business was heard done.
Low sulphur cargo prices were also hard to pin down.
Material remains available in ARA, as well as in western France for the second half of the month.

But dealers said there was little activity and bid levels were far below sellers' numbers, which themselves were heard at $110 fob NWE at one point in the day, when October crude was some 50 cents higher than Monday's close.
